title: Dash resovouir empty, No Automated actions
symptom: When the reservoir of the Pod is empty, but the pod is not expired, no action is taken automatically, so the blood sugar rises without information.
fix: In the dash preferences you can set up an alarm for low reservoir. The minimum is 5.
evidence_quote: In the dash preferences you can set up an alarm for low reservoir. The minimum is 5 this can help as a reminder to change the pod! :)
